_why: Campaigns replace one-change-per-iteration aiming. Eight iterations produced +0.6 capability because every turn targeted whatever gated the benchmark — which is always Accurate Communication, the SMALLEST remaining gap (16.3 of 360). The other 340 points are absent features: Self Follow-Up (+48), Self-Pruning (+51), Learn (+43). A feature cannot be built by a 20-minute turn aimed at a criterion, so a capability now gets a multi-iteration budget and the loop is told to stay on it.
_rules: The campaign sets the TARGET; Codex still reviews every turn and its directive governs HOW, not WHAT. A campaign ends when its exit condition is met or its budget is spent — whichever first — and the orchestrator records which. Never silently extended.

active.name: Measurement surfaces (D-5)
active.goal: Make the seven unmeasurable capabilities scorable. Proactive slice first (the surface that produced 14 of 19 messages in CL-033), then memory recall, then self follow-up. Each small (2-3 cases) but through the REAL path; reported SEPARATELY from the twelve compose cases; existing cases, judge and gate untouched.
active.exit_condition: At least the proactive slice runs end-to-end and reports its own score separately, with D-1 teardown in place so it does not write the owner's live backlog.
active.why_first: Building a capability before it can be measured scores 0 and reads as failure — which is exactly what happened to iterations 3, 5, 6 and 9. The instrument comes first or the next campaign is invisible too.

extended.reason: Budget spent at iteration 14 with NEITHER half of the exit condition met. (1) Codex ruled the slice measures selected text functions under synthetic inputs, not end-to-end real producers. (2) D-1 teardown is absent — the benchmark has written to the owner's live tenant on all 14 runs. Extended rather than closed because C-2 (Self Follow-Up) cannot be scored without an end-to-end proactive measure, so abandoning C-1 half-built would make the next campaign invisible exactly as iterations 3/5/6/9 were. Recorded here because my own rule says a campaign is never silently extended, and iteration 15 had already begun under a spent budget before I noticed.
extended.cost_note: Iterations 13 and 14 were consumed by a data-loss regression and its fix rather than by the campaign goal — the extension buys back that ground, it does not add scope.

exit_condition_status.end_to_end: NOT MET — Codex, iteration 12: synthetic inputs
exit_condition_status.d1_teardown: NOT MET — 14 runs wrote live data

deliverables.what: D-1 teardown: the benchmark stops writing the owner's live backlog. Record every dispatched artifact, and AFTER scoring withdraw suite-CREATED rows via transitionStatus(...,'CANCELLED'); report writes to pre-existing rows as unrevertable; re-count and state whether the tenant returned to baseline.
deliverables.blocks: the whole campaign — 15 runs have now written live data, and D-4 (sampling) multiplies it

deliverables.what: The proactive slice runs END-TO-END through real producers, not selected text functions with synthetic inputs (Codex, iteration 12). P05 must replay fragments through the same persistence/decision sequence production uses.
deliverables.blocks: C-2 Self Follow-Up cannot be scored without it

active.this_iteration_ranks_first: REMEDIATION FIRST (the loop enforces it): iteration 16 closed WEAK, so iteration 17 finishes DEF-159 — both reviewers named the same residual, one typed identity object shared by routing and display. That clears D-9's S3 AND S1: the owner sees names instead of numbers, and it is now DEPLOYED so it counts. THEN C1-D1 (the benchmark's live-tenant writes, 17 runs) — it blocks this campaign's exit, which blocks C-2 Self Follow-Up (+48.2), the largest measurable gain available. C1-D2 (end-to-end slice) after that.
active.orchestrator_note: Drift diagnosis, 2026-08-13, mine not the Builder's: the campaign block set a GOAL and left Codex's directive governing the turn. Each iteration the Builder honestly declared it was following Codex — and each time that was a defect, not the exit condition. Iterations 12 (slice, synthetic), 13 (regression), 14 (its fix), 15 (adjacent durable record). Naming deliverables and ranking them explicitly for the final iteration is the fix; if it still drifts, the campaign mechanism is wrong rather than under-specified.

queued.name: Self Follow-Up
queued.goal: Brain chases its own commitments unprompted: a delegated item whose deadline passes produces a chase without being asked, and a chase that gets no reply escalates. CL-033 evidence: the owner had to say 'chase her' three times and got 'I've made a note of that'.
queued.exit_condition: Grok scores Self Follow-Up >= 60 with basis code-read or live-evidence, on the C-1 surface.

queued.name: Self-Pruning
queued.goal: Junk withdraws itself without being asked. The backlog pruner exists (DEF-132) and is unmeasured; CL-033 shows ten unactionable pushes from one unknown number in a single morning.
queued.exit_condition: Grok scores Self-Pruning >= 55, and a duplicate-sender burst produces at most one grounded digest.

_ranking_note: Queued campaigns are ordered by GAP SIZE, not by convenience. Owner, 2026-08-13: 'i need significant improvement in each iteration' — so the loop works the largest measurable gap available. Self-Pruning (+51.5), Self Follow-Up (+48.2) and Learn (+43.5) dwarf Accurate Communication's remaining 15.3, which has already absorbed eight iterations.
